verses.text: It is better to be poor and live honestly than to be a fool whose words are twisted.
Eagerness without knowledge is not good. If you hurry too much, you will miss the way.
People ruin their lives by their own foolishness, and then their hearts rage against the LORD.
Wealth brings many friends, but poor people are left by their friends.
A false witness will not go unpunished. Whoever pours out lies will not escape.
Many people try to win the favour of a ruler. Everyone is a friend of someone who gives gifts.
All the relatives of a poor person avoid him. How much more do his friends stay away! He chases after them, begging, but they are gone.
Whoever gains wisdom loves themselves. Whoever holds on to understanding will do well.
A false witness will not go unpunished. Whoever pours out lies will be destroyed.
It is not right for a fool to live in luxury, and even worse for a slave to rule over princes.
Good sense makes a person patient. It is to their honour to overlook an offence.
A king's anger is like the roar of a lion, but his kindness is like dew on the grass.
A foolish son is a disaster to his father. A quarrelling wife is like water that keeps dripping.
Houses and wealth are passed down from parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the LORD.
Laziness makes people fall into a deep sleep. Lazy people will go hungry.
Whoever keeps the commands protects their life, but whoever does not care how they live will die.
Whoever is kind to the poor is lending to the LORD, and he will reward them.
Discipline your children while there is still hope. Do not let them destroy their lives.
A hot-tempered person must pay the price. If you rescue them, you will have to do it again.
Listen to advice and accept correction, so that in the end you will be wise.
People make many plans in their hearts, but it is the LORD's purpose that wins.
What people want in a person is kindness. It is better to be poor than to be a liar.
Respect for the LORD leads to life. Then you can rest content, untouched by trouble.
A lazy person buries his hand in the dish and will not even lift it back to his mouth.
Punish a mocker, and simple people will learn good sense. Correct someone with understanding, and they will gain knowledge.
A son who robs his father and drives out his mother brings shame and disgrace.
My son, if you stop listening to teaching, you will wander away from the words of knowledge.
A corrupt witness makes fun of justice, and the mouths of the wicked swallow up evil.
Punishment is ready for mockers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
